svg.text: Gradients: steps, ramps on time or volume, a ramp cut short
Synthetic run logs put through pycorn.run_log_sections; start: 5 ml/min, 0 %B. A section ends where a ramp ends.
Numbered marks: run-log entries, listed under each case with their stored (elapsed) time; the x axis is the wall clock CADET uses.
Gradient 100 %B over 4 min: linear to 100, then holds.
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
2. CV ramp with a flow change (Vc 2 ml)
10 CV = 20 ml pumped by the system pump: 5 ml in the first minute at 5 ml/min, the other 15 ml at 1 ml/min. The ramp takes 16 min, not 4.
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
3. A new gradient takes over from the value reached
A manual Gradient at 3 min starts from the 20 %B reached, not from the old target.
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
4. CV ramp without a column volume
No Vc: the ramp's length is unknown, so %B is unknown until the next %B instruction (with a warning).
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
